# Kairos.ai 優時科技

> AI rebar estimation for the AEC (architecture, engineering, construction)
> industry, plus custom AI systems, backend infrastructure, and data
> platforms. Taiwan-based.

Kairos.ai's flagship product, iTech, converts construction drawings (PDF or
CAD) into accurate rebar estimates and exportable bar-bending schedules,
replacing slow, error-prone manual takeoff. Beyond iTech, Kairos.ai designs
custom AI systems, backend infrastructure, and data platforms for clients.

## Docs

- [Full site content (markdown)](https://www.kairosaitech.com/index.md): About, products, services, languages, and agent-discovery resources in plain markdown.
- [Homepage (HTML)](https://www.kairosaitech.com/): The live site, with structured data (Organization, ProfessionalService, FAQPage, ItemList) in JSON-LD.
